text:
When the moon is a melon slice in the window

and around it is haze, the door closed and the house enchanted

by the blue branches of wisteria, and in the clay fountain there is cold water

and the snow of the cloth, and a wax candle burns

as in childhood, butterflies buzz

the calm, which does not hear my word, resounds.

Then from the blackness of Rembrandtesque corners something suddenly coils

and hides there at hand, but I do not tremble, nor even become afraid...

Solitude in its nets made me prisoner.

The black cat looks into my soul, like century-old eyes,

and in the mirror my double is perhaps my opposite.

I am going sweetly to sleep, good night, night.

translation.title: When the Moon Is a Melon Slice
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the surreal domestic nocturne and its mirror-double unease.
